== frame inside cursor=10,28
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ DENV_EMPTY=
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ DENV_LOCAL=base
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ cd project
|denv: loading .env
|denv: +DENV_LAYER +DENV_EMPTY +DENV_LOCAL
|testuser@<HOST> ~/project $ echo =$DENV_LAYER=:$DENV_EMPTY=:$DENV_LOCAL=
|=first=:changed=:changed=
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~/project $

== frame outside cursor=15,20
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ DENV_EMPTY=
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ DENV_LOCAL=base
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ cd project
|denv: loading .env
|denv: +DENV_LAYER +DENV_EMPTY +DENV_LOCAL
|testuser@<HOST> ~/project $ echo =$DENV_LAYER=:$DENV_EMPTY=:$DENV_LOCAL=
|=first=:changed=:changed=
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~/project $ cd ..
|denv: +DENV_LAYER +DENV_EMPTY +DENV_LOCAL
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo =$DENV_LAYER=:$DENV_EMPTY=:$DENV_LOCAL=
|=base=:=:base=
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $
